gloss: to jump into, to dive into, to rush into

forms.negative: {飛|と}び{込|こ}みませんでした

definitions.gloss: to jump into, to dive into
definitions.explanation: To leap or dive into water, a pool, or another space.

definitions.gloss: to rush into, to burst into
definitions.explanation: To enter a place suddenly and quickly.

definitions.gloss: to come in suddenly (of news, information)
definitions.explanation: For news or information to arrive suddenly and unexpectedly.

notes:
{飛|と}び{込|こ}む is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to jump or rush into.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to fly/jump) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into) → to jump into

ASPECT (ている):
{飛|と}び{込|こ}んでいる indicates a state of having jumped in or being in the process.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{込|こ}む (dive into a pool)
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{込|こ}む (jump into water)
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{込|こ}む (rush into a room)
- ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{込|こ}んでくる (news comes in suddenly)
